goal: Repair the delivered-only Parent recovery gap observed while resuming #246: a retired superseded batch must not suppress native settled-delivery integration and final verification. Preserve S4 settlement, historical batch bytes, native confirmation, current-delivery checks and successful final-HEAD proof; do not re-enroll completed children. Bounded supported input: repository-owned validated batch/Kernel records and trusted workspace; no new storage format or authority model.

acceptance.assertion: Source: user repair request and observeNativeParent in runtime/unattended/batch_git.ts. At tests/unattended-batch-commit.test.ts, a delivered-only Parent with superseded batch history reaches native integration and final verification, preserving retired bytes and prior commits. Absent, declined or cancelled native confirmation has no commit/command effect; exit 7 keeps Parent incomplete; successful proof binds integrated HEAD and replay makes no duplicate commit. Active batches and effective completed batches retain their existing route; missing delivery or changed identity is not accepted.
